candidates.name: Zietlow Installers & Distributors
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet partitions page titled 'Install & Quote' (General Partitions floor-mounted, ceiling-hung, floor-to-ceiling); homepage cites a church bathroom partition installation; company name is installers and distributors.
candidates.reason: Commercial installer and distributor of toilet partitions, lockers and furniture based in North Ridgeville, serving Cleveland and Cuyahoga County. It also supplies General Partitions products, so buy-around risk.

license.name: Zietlow Installers & Distributors
license.registry: City of Cleveland Building & Housing contractor registration (Accela Citizen Access licensee search)
license.note: Business-name searches for 'Zietlow', 'Zietlow Installers' and 'Z Installers' (license type CONTRACTOR) each returned 'Your search returned no results'. Ohio has no state license for partition installation. Cleveland registration is needed to pull permits in the city, and an installer working under a registered general contractor might not hold its own registration. The city says the portal is not a full good-standing list, so confirm by phone at 216-664-2884.
